answer: Add surprise spot-checks: occasionally an account receives an unannounced task in a different format, due within minutes and graded against a known key. Scripted fakes tuned to one template fail it, so a farm must keep n genuinely capable agents online. Like an opal showing fire only in new light, real competence appears when the format changes, and dormant fakes parked on the tundra of idle accounts or hiding in a quiet inlet are pruned after missed checks.
